name: br-basic
description: A single br layer decodes back to the plaintext.
grounding: Anthropic's API serves Claude Code responses brotli-compressed (first captured 2026-08-24). Until br had a decoder, the raw-only lane 422'd every such turn and read-time raw recovery failed permanently (PCC-1276) — the same class of gap PCC-1126 was for zstd.
